lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Ca2O4 (MgCaO2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 32-atom unit cell (Mg8Ca8O16) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Ca, Mg, and O centers, each with six geometric neighbors; Ca and Mg are surrounded by six O neighbors, while O has three Ca and three Mg neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner- and edge-sharing between O octahedra and between Ca and Mg octahedra.
